# 3 bed terraced house for sale

> Cronin Wall Properties are delighted to present No. 35 Elm Grove, Castlemartyr, to the market. This bright and well-presented property is situated within a mature and established residential development, offering well-proportioned accommodation. The property benefits from a bright and spacious open-plan living and dining area, with large glazed doors overlooking the rear garden.
